description: This file implements a specialized configuration class for OCR transformations in Vertex AI using Mistral OCR API. It includes methods to validate environment, generate endpoint URLs, convert URLs to base64 data URIs (both synchronously and asynchronously), and transform OCR requests by pre-processing URLs in documents into data URIs.

classes.name: VertexAIOCRConfig
classes.description: A configuration class for Vertex AI OCR transformations that inherits from MistralOCRConfig, adding methods specific to Vertex AI such as environment validation, URL construction, URL-to-data-URI conversion, and request transformation.

methods.name: Dict validate_environment( self, headers: Dict, model: str, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Validates the environment by retrieving access tokens and setting appropriate headers for Vertex AI OCR.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: dict, litellm_params: Optional[dict] = None, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for Vertex AI OCR endpoint based on provided parameters and environment variables.

methods.name: str _convert_url_to_data_uri_sync(self, url: str)
methods.description: Synchronously converts a URL into a base64-encoded data URI, suitable for local processing without async.

methods.name: str _convert_url_to_data_uri_async(self, url: str)
methods.description: Asynchronously converts a URL into a base64-encoded data URI, suitable for non-blocking operations.

methods.name: OCRRequestData transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Transforms an OCR request by converting document URLs to base64 data URIs synchronously.

methods.name: OCRRequestData async_transform_ocr_request( self, model: str, document: DocumentType, optional_params: dict, headers: dict, **kwargs, )
methods.description: Asynchronously transforms an OCR request by converting document URLs to base64 data URIs.
